description: Search the Agent Exchange x402 census (every resource listed in the CDP Bazaar and PayAI catalogs, probed unpaid). Returns ranked resources with URL, method, price in USD, network, our probe verdict (live = answered a valid 402 today), on-chain payers and settled USD for the seller's payTo, catalogs it appears in, and links to https://bazaar.agentexchange.work/r/<id>. Filter by network (base, solana, base-sepolia, polygon...), max_price_usd, status (live|dead|any).

max_price_usd.description: only resources priced at or below this many USD

network.description: base | base-sepolia | solana | polygon | arbitrum | xlayer | other

query.description: words, a host name, or a URL fragment

name: find_resources
title: Find x402 resources
